title: Vandermonde matrix over the binary field
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a nonzero natural number $\ell$, let $\mathbb{F}_2$ be the field with two elements. The Vandermonde binary matrix on the enumeration of the binary extension of length $\ell$ is the matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$ with rows indexed by $0,\ldots,(k-1)\ell$ and columns indexed by $0,\ldots,2^\ell-1$.
caveat: The defining expression uses upstream constructions whose definitions are not included here, so the meaning of the binary extension enumeration and the precise Vandermonde entries cannot be specified faithfully.
